先把“谁免费”看完，再看“哪里好玩”。SF 居民、湾区九县居民、持 SFPL 图: Read who qualifies before choosing where to go. SF residents, residents of the nine Bay Area counties, SFPL cardholders and out-of-town visitors have different access. Living in Oakland, San José or Daly City does not itself qualify you for SF resident benefits, and one eligible person does not automatically cover the whole group.
没有任何本地证件：先选对所有人开放的福利: No local documents: start with benefits open to everyone
YBCA 每周三展厅对所有人免费，现行时间 11:00–20:00。2026 年: YBCA galleries are free to everyone on Wednesdays, currently 11 AM–8 PM. This rule gives October 7, 14, 21 and 28 in 2026; films, performances and some programs have separate prices.
SFMOMA 开馆时有无需门票的公共艺术区域，主要在一、二层；这不包含整座美术馆: SFMOMA has unticketed public art areas, mainly on Floors 1 and 2, when open; access does not cover the whole museum. It closes on Wednesdays, so avoid pairing its interior with YBCA’s free Wednesday.
SF City Guides 的常规散步导览免费，需提前登记；捐款自愿，私人团另: Regular SF City Guides walks are free with advance registration; donations are optional and private tours cost extra. Choose by that day’s meeting point and walking demands.
游客版｜周三市中心文化半日: Visitor plan | Wednesday downtown culture half-day
编辑建议的 3–4 小时组合，场馆门票可为 $0；交通、餐饮与购物另计。: A suggested 3–4-hour combination with $0 gallery admission; transport, meals and shopping are separate.
在 701 Mission Street 看一个展览即可，先到服务台确认开放展厅: At 701 Mission Street, focus on one exhibition and check open galleries and programs at the visitor desk. There is no need to exhaust every gallery to make a free visit worthwhile.
天气允许，到 Yerba Buena 街区走一小段: A short Yerba Buena neighborhood walk if weather allows
把户外段当作可取消的休息环节。继续下雨就缩短行程，餐饮消费按自己的预算决定。: Treat the outdoor portion as optional. Shorten the visit if rain continues and choose meals within your own budget.
想加导览，另选有真实余位的 City Guides 场次: For a guided walk, choose an available City Guides departure
确认邮件到手后才加入日程；导览终点不一定等于集合点，返程从实际终点查起。: Add a walk after receiving confirmation. The finish may differ from the meeting point, so plan the trip home from the actual endpoint.
刚搬进 SF：三园免费，但要带住址证明: New SF resident: free gardens require address evidence
旧金山植物园、日本茶园与 Conservatory of Flowers 对 S: SF residents receive free admission to the Botanical Garden, Japanese Tea Garden and Conservatory of Flowers. Accepted evidence includes a California license or ID with an SF address, or a recent utility bill or lease plus photo ID; digital images are accepted. Working in SF or holding a library card alone is not address evidence. Visiting relatives qualify separately.
游客也能用：花园免费时段先选一个: Visitors can use free garden windows too
植物园每天 07:30–09:00 免费入场，日本茶园周一、三、五 09:00–: Botanical Garden entry is free daily from 7:30–9 AM; Japanese Tea Garden entry is free Monday, Wednesday and Friday from 9–10 AM. Pick one early window and reach the gate before it ends. Avoid an expensive taxi just to save admission if the early start is impractical. Special programs may cost extra.
住在湾区其他城市：周六美术馆与自己的发卡馆: Elsewhere in the Bay Area: museum Saturdays and your own library
UCSF 的 2026 年信息与 SF Ballet 的馆方合作页面支持 Fre: UCSF’s 2026 information and SF Ballet’s museum-partnership page support the Free Saturdays rules: de Young and Legion of Honor offer general admission to residents of Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano and Sonoma counties. Check museum ticketing for that date’s availability, address verification and exceptions; do not assume special exhibitions are included. Choose one museum for an unhurried visit.
查看 de Young 当前 Free Saturdays 票务: Check current de Young Free Saturdays ticketing
此处核对当日例外、住址证明与特展价格，再决定是否预约。: Check exceptions, address verification and special-exhibition prices before reserving.
SFPL Discover & Go：先预约，最后再下载: SFPL Discover & Go: reserve first, download last
须是 San Francisco 市县居民，用自己的 SFPL 卡号和 PIN: You must live in the City and County of San Francisco and sign in with your SFPL card and PIN; Teacher Cards are excluded. Residents elsewhere should check their own library’s official eligibility.
最多同时保留两项预约，可查看含当前月份在内的三个月；每月 1 日放出新月份。场馆: Up to two active reservations are allowed, with a three-month booking window including the current month and a new month released on the 1st. Venues, dates and party sizes depend on available passes; popular venues may be unavailable.
下载或打印后不能取消。先确认全家时间，再取票；票只限实名预约者在指定日期使用，部: Once downloaded or printed, a pass cannot be canceled. Confirm your group’s plans before retrieving it. Passes are for the named person and date; some venues limit use to once a year or require a child.
带孩子或持福利卡：问清几位免费，以及是否含特展: With children or benefit cards: verify party size and exhibition coverage
SFMOMA 已公布 2026 年 10 月 25 日免费家庭日：一名 18 岁: SFMOMA lists October 25, 2026 as a Free Family Day: up to two adults get free general admission with one child or teen age 18 or under. Tickets open two weeks ahead; surcharged exhibitions cost extra. EBT or Medi-Cal households should check each venue’s Museums for All rules, since residency, documents, guest limits and prices differ.
出门前核对：今天开放吗、免费范围是什么、预约成功了吗、谁的证件需要原件或照片？: Before leaving: is the venue open, what is free, is the reservation confirmed, and whose documents are needed?
只算门票为零：交通、停车、午餐、茶点、纪念品和自愿捐款单列。: Zero admission is only one budget line; list transit, parking, lunch, refreshments, souvenirs and optional donations separately.
带访客的人不要替全组选择居民票；有任何一位不满足资格，就为那位选适用的票种。: Do not select resident tickets for an entire visiting group; choose the correct ticket for each person.
不需要为一次免费入场申请并不适合自己的信用卡或购买会员，先使用已有资格。: Use eligibility you already have instead of opening an unsuitable credit card or buying membership for a single free visit.
